description: Look up a run started earlier with rove_run_task (for example after it returned status "running"). Waits up to waitSec seconds (default 20, max 25) for the run to finish, so one call usually replaces many. Returns status, the answer once finished (use find/maxChars to read just part of a long answer; this is free), and retryable/hint fields; when the hint says finished, do not call again. Only runs started by the same account or key are visible.

find.description: Only return lines containing any of these words or phrases (case-insensitive), with one line of context each.

maxChars.description: Return at most this many characters of the answer/page text (200-100000). The result says truncated and totalChars when it was cut.

waitSec.description: Seconds to wait for the run to finish (0 = check once)

name: rove_get_run

answerTruncated.description: Rove stored only the first part of a very long answer

duplicate.description: An earlier run with the same idempotencyKey was returned; nothing new was charged

hint.description: What to do next, in plain words

matches.description: Matching lines, when find was given

pageCount.description: Pages the agent visited (listed only with includeLinks)

retryAfterSec.description: Seconds to wait before calling again

runStatus.description: Raw run status while still running

schemaValid.description: With output_schema: whether the answer data matched it

shownChars.description: Characters returned in the text content

status.description: completed, partial, running, waiting, failed, … or error

totalChars.description: Characters in the full answer or page text

truncated.description: True when maxChars cut the text short

title: Get a Rove run result
